[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a detailed overview of how Azul is played, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Objective: Create the most stunning mosaic by collecting and placing tiles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Gameplay: Involves drafting tiles, placement on a personal board, scoring based on sets created, and game ends after 5-6 rounds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Key Mechanics: Tile drafting, pattern-building, and blocking opponents.
